[[Constable/Legends|Constable]] '''Girath''' was a surly, tight-lipped, [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Cult of Veroleem]] as the leader of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] personnel in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[New Promise]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]].<ref name="TUR" />
